name: 그림자 세계
prompt:
STYLE LOCK — Crystal Quest Painterly World Map.
Use the attached chapter-1-library-map.webp as the authoritative STYLE reference. Match its rendering, color relationships, material treatment, detail density and atmospheric depth, not its specific library building or geography.
Create a finely hand-painted premium fantasy mobile RPG world map. Use soft controlled painterly brush texture, delicate colored edges without black outlines, dimensional cream stone, naturally layered cliffs, nuanced lush foliage, tiny flowers and climbing ivy. Use warm sunlight, cool teal-violet shadows, golden paths, turquoise water where appropriate, blue atmospheric distance and softly billowing white clouds. Violet-blue crystals have translucent faceted surfaces, white highlights and restrained magical glow; gold is a restrained waypoint accent.
Use an elevated three-quarter map view, clear destination architecture, readable winding routes, crisp nearby terrain and softer lower-contrast distant scenery. Keep navigation landmarks distinct at portrait mobile size. The image must look like another region painted by the same artist as the style reference. Preserve the region's own subject and geography rather than copying the reference's buildings.


Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Wordoria Crystal Quest story world map.
Scene: World 6-2, Shadow World (그림자 세계). An eerie dark enchanted realm: floating slate cliffs over a midnight abyss, twisted ancient trees with fine silvery leaves, indigo shadow woods, ruined stone arches, narrow stone bridges, cold black-blue water and drifting lavender fog. The winding descending route leads to a monumental shadow portal inside a ruined gothic gate at bottom center. A crescent moon and faraway silhouettes establish depth. No library building. Beautiful mysterious age-appropriate fantasy, with painterly elegance rather than gore.
Reference roles: Image 1 = authoritative STYLE reference chapter-1-library-map.webp. This is a NEW world; no target layout image exists.
Lighting override explicitly requested by the user: spooky DARK NIGHT, deep indigo/blue-violet scenery, pale moonlight from upper left instead of daytime sunlight, restrained cyan rim light and violet waypoint glow. Retain the reference's delicate brushwork, dimensional stone, intricate foliage and atmospheric layering. Dark colored areas must have clear hue separation; keep the road and crystals readable. The fixed style block's daylight palette is overridden only for this requested nocturnal setting.
Composition: tall portrait 1:3, target 1024 x 3072. One continuous full-bleed scrolling map. Twenty well-spaced waypoint stations along a SINGLE continuous winding route from top left gradually DOWN to bottom center. Seven gentle alternating traverses connected by paths, bridges and stairs. No branches that imply a wrong stage order. Keep waypoints at least 5% from edges. Leave sufficient landing space around each crystal for a mobile selection button.
Gameplay contract: exactly 20 distinct violet-blue crystal waypoints on gold-rimmed circular pedestals. ONE prominent faceted crystal per pedestal, consistent size. No decorative purple crystals or extra gold circles anywhere else. Stage order and normalized centers: 1: (20%, 6%); 2: (43%, 9%); 3: (70%, 12%); 4: (83%, 17%); 5: (60%, 21%); 6: (34%, 25%); 7: (17%, 30%); 8: (40%, 34%); 9: (67%, 38%); 10: (82%, 43%); 11: (62%, 48%); 12: (36%, 52%); 13: (18%, 57%); 14: (40%, 61%); 15: (68%, 65%); 16: (82%, 70%); 17: (62%, 75%); 18: (35%, 80%); 19: (20%, 86%); 20: (52%, 92%). Build the paths and landings around those centers. All 20 must be individually visible, separated, and unobscured by trees, fog, bridges or portal. The final waypoint is in front of the bottom shadow portal. All route segments must be visibly connected. No text or numbers printed in the artwork.

Avoid coarse low-poly geometry, chunky toy-like 3D rendering, plastic surfaces, flat oversaturated green terrain, black cartoon outlines, pixel art, gritty photorealism, muddy dark palettes, excessive bloom and repetitive noisy detail. No characters, monsters, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, logos, watermark, frames or black side borders. Do not obscure the route or waypoint crystals with foliage, clouds or effects. Do not introduce buildings or narrative elements unrelated to the requested world.
